name: Rare-event boundary-response transfer
inputs: Full and restricted block laws with a uniform response estimate.
outputs: A two-sided error budget between their boundary influence coefficients.
obligations: Bound derivatives or transport responses, not only bad-event probability.
Prove a retained contraction margin uniformly along the physical tuning.
failure_check: A rare event can have a large derivative; deterministic gauge isometries preserve Wasserstein influence coefficients.

name: Tightness with non-escaping observables
inputs: Renormalized observables and a common state space at every cutoff.
outputs: A candidate subsequential law with precisely stated moment transfers.
obligations: Prove uniform moment/tree bounds and a nonzero fixed-distance observable.
Establish uniqueness, locality, rotational invariance and the required positive physical gap.
failure_check: Unit normalization does not prevent mass from escaping to infinite physical energy.
